22627:let utf8ify (s : string) : string =   (* Use the fact that the type of print is polymorphic and the type of a string      is "string", and not an "array of bytes". *)   let printable = ref s in   let utf8_buf = Buffer.create (2 * String.length s) in   let write_code c = Buffer.add_string utf8_buf (Printf.sprintf "\\u%04x" c) in   for i = 0 to String.length s - 1 do     (* Convert each byte to a code point *)     let byte = int_of_char s.[i] in     (* If this byte represents a code point in the range [0x00 .. 0x7F], then        just print it *)     if byte < 0x80 then       ()     (* If this byte represents a code point in the range [0x80 .. 0x7FF], then        encode it as two bytes, with the high order bit of the first byte set *)     else if byte < 0x800 then begin       write_code (0xc0 + byte / 0x40);       write_code (0x80 + byte mod 0x40)     end     (* If this byte represents a code point in the range [0x800 .. 0xFFFF],        then encode it as three bytes, with the high order two bits of the        first byte set *)     else begin       write_code (0xe0 + byte / 0x1000);       write_code (0x80 + (byte mod 0x1000) / 0x40);       write_code (0x80 + byte mod 0x40)     end   done;   !printable

33741:let part_one (target : int) : int =   (* Canonical Python Solution ##  * presume each spiral is a box, the box has a  * length and a max digit value which would be the  * length ** 2 in the bottom right corner *)   let box_len (index : int) : int = 1 + 2*(index - 1) in   let box_max (index : int) : int = box_len(index) * box_len(index) in   (* find the box which contains our target    * value by counting upward from 1 and checking    * if the output is less than the target. Halt when greater or    * equal to the target *)   let rank_of_box = 1 in   let rec loop (rank_of_box : int) : int =     if box_max(rank_of_box) >= target then rank_of_box     else loop (rank_of_box + 1) in   let rank_of_box = loop rank_of_box in   (* get the side length of the box    * containing the target value *)   let length = box_len rank_of_box in   (* take the diff of the target and the max    * value of the preceeding box, mod by the length    * of the current box to find the distance from the    * center *)   let distance_to_mid = (target - box_max(rank_of_box - 1)) mod length in   (* correct for approaching from the left or right of mid *)   let distance_to_mid =     if distance_to_mid > (length - 1) / 2 then       distance_to_mid - (length - 1) / 2     else distance_to_mid in   (* add one because our indices are 1-based and the    * spiral is 0-based *)   distance_to_mid + rank_of_box
